clues: Bernard Leach set up a pottery here in 1920 that launched British studio pottery.
Painters Ben Nicholson and Alfred Wallis worked in this town.
Barbara Hepworth's home and sculpture garden here is now a museum.
A Tate gallery here overlooks Porthmeor Beach.
This artists' harbour town on Cornwall's north coast appears in the nursery rhyme 'As I was going to ...'.
